mapper.select: SELECT mpad.PRODUCTION_NO, mpad.FACTORY_CODE, mpad.YEAR, mpad.MONTH, mpad.PRODUCT_CODE, mpad.PRODUCT_DESC, mpad.START_DATE, mpad.ADJUST_TYPE, mpad.ADJUST_QTY, mppf.PRO_SIZE, mppf.CHANNEL, mppf.LOCATION_TYPE FROM t_mp_month_plan_adjust_detail mpad LEFT JOIN t_mp_month_plan_prod_final mppf ON mpad.PRODUCTION_NO = mppf.PRODUCTION_NO AND mpad.FACTORY_CODE = mppf.FACTORY_CODE AND mpad.YEAR = mppf.YEAR AND mpad.MONTH = mppf.MONTH WHERE IFNULL(mpad.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND mpad.NOTICE_NO = #{noticeNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY mpad.ADJUST_QTY DESC,mpad.PRODUCTION_NO
